description: Builds a versioned ZIP-level employer-establishment and NAICS coverage baseline from Census ZIP Business Patterns.
retry: Exponential backoff for discovery and source downloads; fail after four total attempts.
checkpoint: Source archives and derived artifacts are run-scoped; publication occurs only after all coverage gates pass.
idempotency: Each build produces an immutable release and updates current.json only after publication.
cancellation: Abort active downloads and leave no shared lock; unpublished staging remains isolated by run ID.
retention_profile: Retain immutable public aggregate releases until explicitly removed by an approved retention operation.
